lines.en: label beachsevenio1:
scene iobeachint1
: Hi.
: Oh, okay. Well, I guess my turn is over now. Later, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。那看来轮到我的部分结束了。回见，老师！

lines.en: : Later, Rin. See you tomorrow unless something tragic suddenly happens to me.
lines.zh: : 回见，Rin。明天见——除非我突然遭遇什么悲剧。

lines.en: scene iobeachint2
: Sorry. Did I interrupt something?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我是不是打扰到什么了？

lines.en: : Yes, Io. You quite literally interrupted something. I have no idea what else that word could possibly mean to you if you need to ask me this question right now.
lines.zh: : 是的，Io。你确实是字面意义上地打断了某件事。如果你现在还需要问我这个问题，我真不知道那个词对你来说还能有什么别的含义。

lines.en: : Asking that was mostly just a formality I decided to employ to appear more normal and less rude.
lines.zh: : 问那句多半只是我决定采用的一套礼节，好让自己看起来更正常、更不失礼。

lines.en: : I technically knew I was interrupting something. I just didn’t really care because my thing is more important than condoms.
lines.zh: : 严格来说我知道自己在打断什么。我只是不太在乎，因为我的事比避孕套重要。

lines.en: : Most things are. But go ahead, shoot. Just let the record show that I have plans both tonight and tomorrow. So if you’re trying to hang out with me, you’re going to need to schedule something ASAP.
lines.zh: : 大多数事情都是。不过说吧，尽管讲。只是请记录在案：我今晚和明天都有安排。所以如果你想约我，得尽快排期。

lines.en: : I probably won’t have time to hang out at all this weekend, so you can give my slot to somebody else. I’m too busy being mature and working damage control to be frantic and anxious right now.
lines.zh: : 这个周末我大概根本没时间出去玩，你可以把我的名额让给别人。我现在正忙着做个成熟的人、忙着收拾残局，没空发狂和焦虑。

lines.en: : Damage control for what exactly?
lines.zh: : 收拾什么残局？

lines.en: : Before I answer that question, are you also only asking something to appear more normal and less rude? Because it’d be really weird if you didn’t actually know yet and I’m pretty sure you do.
lines.zh: : 在我回答之前，你问这个也只是为了显得更正常、更不失礼吧？因为如果你其实还不知道，那就太奇怪了——而我相当肯定你是知道的。

lines.en: : Does it involve a certain maid and certain things that maid may have done before she was a maid?
lines.zh: : 是不是跟某个女仆、以及那个女仆在做女仆之前可能做过的某些事有关？

lines.en: : Okay, so you {i}do{/i} know.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来你{i}确实{/i}知道。

lines.en: : I take it Uta’s not handling it well then? And that you need me to go cheer her up since there’s only so much you can do on your own?
lines.zh: : 那我猜 Uta 现在状态不太好？而你需要我去让她振作起来，因为你一个人能做的终究有限？

lines.en: : No. In fact, I’d like you to do the exact {i}opposite{/i} of that since she really, really likes you and will probably start crying out of shame or something if she sees you right now.
lines.zh: : 不。事实上，我希望你做完全{i}相反{/i}的事——因为她真的、真的很喜欢你，要是现在看到你，搞不好会羞耻得哭出来。

lines.en: : So just...avoid her all weekend? That’s easier said than done. Especially immediately after I just alluded to something tragic happening. Uta could very well be that tragic thing, Io.
lines.zh: : 所以就……整个周末都躲着她？说起来容易做起来难。尤其在我刚暗示过可能发生什么悲剧之后。Uta 很可能就是那个悲剧本身，Io。

lines.en: scene iobeachint3
: It’ll probably be as simple as to just not go looking for her, honestly. I was able to talk to Touka about getting Uta and me a room of our own and she’s in there with AC blasting right now.
lines.zh: : 老实说，大概只要别主动去找她就行。我跟 Touka 谈过了，给 Uta 和我弄了间属于我们自己的房间，她现在就在里面吹着空调。

lines.en: : You talked to Touka? Willingly? On your own?
lines.zh: : 你跟 Touka 谈了？主动的？一个人？

lines.en: scene iobeachint4
: You should have seen me in the classroom. I stood up and yelled at everyone and I didn’t even have a panic attack until I got home.
lines.zh: : 你是没看见我在教室里的样子。我站起来冲所有人喊，而且直到回家才惊恐发作。

lines.en: : I have to be serious Io right now, Sensei. Uta’s always the one looking out for me and if I can’t repay that when she needs me most, what good even am I?
lines.zh: : 我现在必须认真一点了，老师。一直都是 Uta 在照顾我，如果在她最需要我的时候我却连这点都回报不了，我还能有什么用？

lines.en: : And don’t actually answer that question because I already know I’m just no good at all.
lines.zh: : 还有，别真的回答这个问题——因为我已经知道自己根本就是个没用的人。

lines.en: : Walk with me.
lines.zh: : 陪我走走。

lines.en: : Okay.
scene iobeachint5
Io and I take off down the beach as I start walking her back to the inn. And while it’s nice to see this protective side of her, I can’t help but feel bad about the circumstances that brought it out.
lines.zh: Io 和我沿着沙滩出发，我开始送她回旅馆。虽然看到她这副护着别人的一面是件好事，但引出这一面的处境让我难免难受。

lines.en: Feeling bad about the leakage of someone’s childhood nudes is kind of just the baseline of having compassion, though. So don’t give me too much credit when I’m pretty sure {i}everyone{/i} feels bad right now.
lines.zh: 不过，为别人童年裸照外流而难过，基本只是有同情心的底线而已。所以别太抬举我——我敢说现在{i}每个人{/i}都不好受。

lines.en: : So, like...I heard about this from Ami obviously. But I didn’t really pry any details out of her.
lines.zh: : 那个……我当然是听 Ami 说的。但我没怎么从她嘴里撬出细节。

lines.en: : You didn’t get any pictures then?
lines.zh: : 那你没拿到照片？

lines.en: : Not this time, no. Though, I’m not really sure what sort of details they’d provide if I did.
lines.zh: : 这次没有。不过我也不确定就算拿到了，那些照片能提供什么细节。

lines.en: : None really. I just wanted to confirm that I don’t need to snatch your phone away and throw it into the ocean.
lines.zh: : 其实什么也提供不了。我只是想确认一下，我需不需要把你的手机抢过来扔进海里。

lines.en: : You probably still do, to be honest. It’s practically a portable bank of potential charges against me at this point.
lines.zh: : 老实说，你大概还是需要的。到了这个地步，它基本上就是一座装着可能用来指控我的罪证的可移动银行。

lines.en: scene iobeachint6

: Sure, but at least you’re talking about stuff you obtained with consent. Or at least I {i}hope{/i} you’re talking about stuff you obtained with consent. But I care less about everyone else than I do about Uta right now.
lines.zh: : 当然，但至少你谈的是你经过对方同意才拿到的东西。或者至少我{i}希望{/i}你谈的是经过同意拿到的。不过我现在关心的不是其他人，是 Uta。

lines.en: : Which is also just how I feel literally all of the time. But it’s especially true right now since our entire class has suddenly violated her privacy. Albeit accidentally, but still.
lines.zh: : 其实我平时也一直是这种感觉。只是现在格外强烈，因为我们全班突然侵犯了她的隐私。虽然是出于意外，但还是侵犯了。

lines.en: : It was just...a random text chain then? Like, {i}everyone{/i} got them?
lines.zh: : 所以就只是……一条到处乱转的短信链？也就是说，{i}每个人{/i}都收到了？

lines.en: : I originally thought it was just our class, but...yeah. I think pretty much any cell phone inside of the school was sent those pictures.
lines.zh: : 我原本以为只有我们班，不过……是啊。我觉得学校里几乎每一部手机都被发了那些照片。

lines.en: : And given how many people are acquainted with Uta as a result of her merely existing, it didn’t take long for word to get around about who was {i}in{/i} those pictures.
lines.zh: : 再加上 Uta 光是存在着就认识那么多人，没过多久，大家就都在传照片里的{i}人{/i}是谁了。

lines.en: : And how is she handling all of this? Apart from bad enough to warrant damage control and the very rare “Serious Io?”
lines.zh: : 那她现在怎么样？除了糟糕到需要你来做危机公关、以及那句非常罕见的「认真的 Io？」之外。

lines.en: : Exactly how I thought she would if she was ever confronted with news of her past getting out.
lines.zh: : 完全就是我想象中她得知过去被公开时会有的反应。

lines.en: : She’s still smiling and saying everything is fine. That she doesn’t care if anyone knows this about her since it’s just a “part of who she is” or whatever else her counselors fed her to make her accept things.
lines.zh: : 她还是在笑，还是说一切都好。说她不在乎别人知道这些，因为这只是「她的一部分」——或者她的心理辅导员为了让她接受现实而塞给她的别的什么说法。

lines.en: : It’s all a lie, though. Surely {i}you{/i} know Uta’s smile by now. So you’d be able to discern a forced one with no issues at all. She’s operating off of auto-pilot, basically.
lines.zh: : 但那全是谎话。{i}你{/i}现在总该认得 Uta 的笑容了吧。所以你一定能毫无障碍地分辨出哪一副是硬挤出来的。她现在基本就是靠着自动驾驶在运转。

lines.en: : Like, I didn’t even want her to {i}come{/i} here but she just kept insisting on it because she just wants everything to be normal again when she knows deep down, nothing will ever be “normal” again.
lines.zh: : 就……我甚至不想让她{i}来{/i}这里，可她一直坚持要来，因为她只想让一切回到正常——可她心里清楚，什么都不会再「正常」了。

lines.en: : You don’t know that for sure, though. Like, apart from Ami the day it happened and you right now, no one’s said anything about this to me {i}at all.{/i} So I can’t imagine anyone is talking to {i}her{/i} about it.
lines.zh: : 不过这一点你并不确定啊。除了事发当天的 Ami 和现在的你之外，{i}根本{/i}没有别人跟我提过半个字。所以我很难想象会有人去跟{i}她{/i}谈这件事。

lines.en: : It’s not about whether anyone talks about it, Sensei. It’s about whether or not they know.
lines.zh: : 重点不在于有没有人谈，老师。重点在于他们知不知道。

lines.en: : Uta’s cultivated an image for herself that she’s {i}proud{/i} of. She’s finally going to a school where rumors about her aren’t circulating like crazy. Or...at least they {i}weren’t.{/i} But that’s obviously changed.
lines.zh: : Uta 给自己经营出了一个她引以为{i}傲{/i}的形象。她终于去了一所不会疯传她流言的学校。或者……至少{i}曾经{/i}不传了。但那显然已经变了。

lines.en: : So now it’s back to square one and she’s never going to feel comfortable again. Which sucks {i}extra{/i} hard since there’s literally nowhere else to run to now.
lines.zh: : 所以现在一切回到原点，她再也不会自在了。而这{i}格外{/i}让人难受，因为她现在真的无处可逃。

lines.en: : Is she still going to school? Do the teachers know about-
lines.zh: : 她还在上学吗？老师们知道吗——

lines.en: : {i}Everyone{/i} knows. Yet, Uta’s still showing up like nothing even happened.
lines.zh: : {i}所有人{/i}都知道。可 Uta 还是照常来上学，就像什么都没发生过一样。

lines.en: scene iobeachint7

: Miss Imai’s been trying to talk to her and, like, {i}be supportive{/i} or whatever. But it’s not going to change anything. So the only way for Uta to overcome it is to {i}literally{/i} change herself. Again. And that worries me.
lines.zh: : Imai 老师一直在试图跟她谈，那个……{i}表示支持{/i}什么的。但那改变不了任何事。所以 Uta 要跨过去，唯一的办法就是{i}真的{/i}改变自己。再一次。而这让我很担心。

lines.en: : She’s always been stronger than me. And I’ve looked up to her since we met because of that...
lines.zh: : 她一直都比我坚强。从我们认识起，我就因为她这一点而仰望着她……

lines.en: : But there’s only so much a person can take and, if she has to keep rewriting herself like this, who’s to say what will be left of the girl at the core of it all?
lines.zh: : 但一个人能承受的终究有限，如果她必须像这样不断重写自己，谁能说清最核心的那个女孩最后还会剩下什么？

lines.en: : Well, I was about to ask how I can help, but it doesn’t seem like I {i}can.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我本来想问我能帮上什么忙，但看起来我{i}帮不上{/i}。

lines.en: scene iobeachint8
: I just don’t understand how this could have been avoided...
lines.zh: : 我只是不明白，这种事本来怎么可能避免得了……

lines.en: : Like, it’s {i}weird.{/i} This isn’t just one person we’re talking about. This isn’t pictures being sent to you or me or her but an {i}entire fucking school.{/i} How does that even happen?
lines.zh: : 就是……这事{i}很怪{/i}。我们说的不是某一个人。不是照片发给了你、发给了我或者发给了她，而是发给了{i}整整一整个操蛋的学校{/i}。这到底是怎么发生的？

lines.en: scene iobeachint9
: {i}Who{/i} would do that? Why is everyone so fucking evil? Why can’t we just live our lives without people trying to rape us or exploit us everywhere we look?
lines.zh: : {i}谁{/i}会干这种事？为什么每个人都这么他妈的恶毒？为什么我们就不能好好过日子，非得到处都是想强奸我们、想利用我们的人？

lines.en: scene iobeachint10
: Sorry, I...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我……

lines.en: : I’m just not really handling this as well as I hoped.
lines.zh: : 我只是……这件事我并没有自己希望的那么能扛。

lines.en: : And it’s dredging up a bunch of shitty memories that will inevitably make {i}me{/i} shitty as a result. And so both of us are just going to dissolve into nothing but scorn and shame and then eventually disappear.
lines.zh: : 而且它翻出了一大堆糟糕的回忆，那些回忆最终必然会把{i}我{/i}也变糟。所以我们两个人都会溶解成只剩轻蔑与羞耻的东西，然后就这么消失掉。

lines.en: : Well, I’d greatly prefer if neither of you {i}disappeared.{/i} Weird things just...happen sometimes. Especially here, of all places.
lines.zh: : 我倒是非常希望你们俩都别{i}消失{/i}。奇怪的事就是……偶尔会发生。尤其在这里，在这么多地方之中的这里。

lines.en: scene iobeachint11
: What is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思？

lines.en: scene iobeachint12
: Uta will know what it means. And if she doesn’t, she’ll learn soon.
lines.zh: : Uta 会明白那是什么意思。就算她现在不明白，很快也会懂的。

lines.en: : This place is nothing like she hopes...but I think she’ll get through it, Io.
lines.zh: : 这地方跟她希望的完全不同……但我觉得她能撑过去，Io。

lines.en: : We both know that shame never fully wears off. But it does get easier to ignore sometimes. And if Uta’s come this far, who are we to fear where else she’ll go?
lines.zh: : 我们都清楚，羞耻感是永远不会彻底消退的。但它有时候确实会变得更容易无视。既然 Uta 已经走到这一步，我们又凭什么去害怕她还会走到哪里？

lines.en: : Yes, but at least {i}we{/i} don’t have our shame paraded in front of us and distributed to all of our peers. If anything, Uta has it even {i}worse{/i} than we do.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但至少{i}我们{/i}的羞耻没被拉出来游街、分发给所有同龄人。要说的话，Uta 比我们还要{i}惨{/i}。

lines.en: : She can’t even {i}hide.{/i} So how are we supposed to help as two people who do nothing but {i}avoid{/i} our pasts?
lines.zh: : 她连{i}躲{/i}都躲不掉。那我们两个只会{i}逃避{/i}过去的人，又能怎么帮她？

lines.en: : I confront my past every day now. The issue with me is that I always let it win. But Uta isn’t like us. And if she’s as strong as you say, maybe we can learn from her how to become better people after all of this blows over.
lines.zh: : 我现在每天都在面对自己的过去。我的问题在于我总是让它赢。但 Uta 跟我们不一样。如果她真像你说的那么坚强，也许等这一切过去，我们反而能从她身上学会怎么变成更好的人。

lines.en: scene iobeachint13
: And if it doesn’t?...
lines.zh: : 如果过不去呢？……

lines.en: : If she lets the past win the same way you do, won’t she become just as much of a monster?
lines.zh: : 如果她像你一样让过去赢了，她不也会变成同样的怪物吗？

lines.en: : There’s a chance nothing good comes out of this. That someone is sending those things to all of us because they want to {i}break{/i} her then marvel at the mess that she becomes.
lines.zh: : 有可能这件事不会带来任何好结果。有人把这些东西发给我们所有人，就是想{i}击垮{/i}她，然后再惊叹于她变成的那副狼藉模样。

lines.en: : Just, if Uta breaks, so will I. How could I not when she’s been my anchor this whole time?
lines.zh: : 只是……如果 Uta 垮了，我也会垮。她一直是我的锚，我怎么可能不垮？

lines.en: : You’ve wrapped too much of yourself up in her, Io. You’re the only one who gets to define who and what you are.
lines.zh: : 你在她身上缠绕了太多自己的东西，Io。能定义你是谁、你是什么的，只有你自己。

lines.en: : No...I’m not. That choice was made for me a long time ago and there is nothing I can do to escape it. Uta’s the one who got out. She {i}knows{/i} how to become something else.
lines.zh: : 不……不是。那个选择很久以前就替我做好了，我做什么都逃不掉。逃出去的是 Uta。她{i}知道{/i}怎么变成另一种东西。

lines.en: : Then I say we let her.
lines.zh: : 那我说，就让她去吧。

lines.en: scene iobeachint14
: If she wants to act like nothing happened, let her. If she wants to lie in bed with the AC blasting while avoiding all human contact, let her.
lines.zh: : 如果她想装作什么都没发生，就随她。如果她想躺在床上吹着空调、避开一切人际接触，也随她。

lines.en: : But what if she wants to do something bad?...
lines.zh: : 可如果她想做点坏事呢？……

lines.en: : Do we {i}let her{/i} do that as well?
lines.zh: : 那我们也要{i}随她{/i}吗？

lines.en: : There’s something weird about all of this, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这一切有点不对劲，老师。

lines.en: : Something I can’t quite put my finger on.
lines.zh: : 有某种我说不上来的东西。

lines.en: scene black
: There’s no way real life is supposed to be this depressing, right?...
lines.zh: : 现实生活不可能本该这么压抑吧？……

lines.en: scene iobeachint15
Io stayed quiet for the rest of the walk back when I couldn’t come up with an answer. I still don’t know what “real life” is.
lines.zh: 在回程剩下的路上，Io 一直沉默，因为我想不出答案。我到现在也不知道「现实生活」是什么。

lines.en: {size=-4}Because if Descartes is right and my previous statements confirms as much, this life {i}is{/i} real. And that, by even being able to wonder if it is or not, I’m creating some sort of paradox where I have {i}realer{/i} thoughts somewhere else.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}因为如果笛卡尔是对的，而我前面的那些陈述也印证了这一点，那么这辈子{i}就是{/i}真实的。而单凭我能够去怀疑它是否真实这一点，我就制造出了某种悖论——在别处的我，有着{i}更真实{/i}的念头。{/size}

lines.en: Then {i}that{/i} me has “realer” thoughts and it goes on and on and on for all eternity.
lines.zh: 那么{i}那个{/i}我就拥有「更真实」的念头，如此循环往复，直至永恒。

lines.en: Yes, strange things happen in this place. And yes, I’ve been taught to believe that most of them are {i}unrealistic.{/i} That they don’t fit in with what “reality” is meant to be. But that’s just {i}it.{/i}
lines.zh: 没错，这个地方会发生奇怪的事。没错，我被教导着去相信它们大多都是{i}不现实的{/i}——它们不符合「现实」应有的样子。但问题就{i}在这儿{/i}。

lines.en: I think that way because that’s how I was {i}taught{/i} to think. And if what someone else was taught contradicts that, {i}that{/i} creates a paradox too.
lines.zh: 我之所以那样想，是因为我被{i}教{/i}着那样想。而如果别人被教的跟我相冲突，{i}那{/i}也制造出一个悖论。

lines.en: {size=-4}Who says “real life” can’t be this depressing? Who says it isn’t the most depressing thing that can possibly exist? And why would we even listen to whoever that is in the first place when this world is supposed to be what {i}we{/i} make of it? Not them.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}谁说「现实生活」不能这么压抑？谁说它不是可能存在的最压抑的东西？再说，这个世界本该由{i}我们{/i}来塑造，我们凭什么要去听那个人的话？不是他们。{/size}

lines.en: Be it fact or fiction, truth or false, what matters most is how it makes you feel.
lines.zh: 是事实还是虚构，是真还是假，最要紧的是它让你有什么感觉。

lines.en: I don’t want to leave this place because I don’t think it should exist.
lines.zh: 我想离开这个地方，不是因为我觉得它不该存在。

lines.en: I want to leave it because it makes me sad.
lines.zh: 我想离开，是因为它让我难过。

lines.en: : I went back to that hole recently...
lines.zh: : 我最近回了那个洞……

lines.en: : The one where we kissed for the first time.
lines.zh: : 我们第一次接吻的那个。

lines.en: : Uhh...cool? Kind of a weird time to bring that up, though.
lines.zh: : 呃……挺好的？不过现在提这个时机挺怪的。

lines.en: : I saw my mother there.
lines.zh: : 我在那儿看见了我妈妈。

lines.en: : And then she was gone.
lines.zh: : 然后她就不见了。

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : I...don’t think it was {i}actually{/i} her. I think I was just seeing things in the dark or...something like that.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得那{i}真的{/i}是她。我觉得我只是黑暗里看花了眼，或者……类似那样。

lines.en: : But I’m afraid to go back now.
lines.zh: : 但我现在不敢回去了。

lines.en: : And I wonder if...
lines.zh: : 我在想，会不会……

lines.en: : I wonder if I only saw that in the first place because something or...someone didn’t want me to keep looking around in there.
lines.zh: : 我在想，我当初之所以会看见那个，会不会是因为有什么东西……或者什么人，不想让我继续在里面到处看。

lines.en: : That’s-
lines.zh: : 那太——

lines.en: scene iobeachint16
: Weird, I know. And...kind of random.
lines.zh: : 很怪，我知道。而且……有点突然。

lines.en: : But all this talk or...{i}lack{/i} of talk about what’s real or make believe has got me thinking.
lines.zh: : 但这些关于什么是真实、什么是虚构的讨论——或者说{i}没有{/i}讨论——让我想了很多。

lines.en: : If this {i}is{/i} just some kind of story...and all {i}we{/i} are is characters dropped in to make it more interesting...
lines.zh: : 如果这{i}只是{/i}某个故事……而{i}我们{/i}只是为了让它更有趣而被丢进去的角色……

lines.en: : What reason would there possibly be to keep us from exploring?
lines.zh: : 那有什么理由要阻止我们去探索？

lines.en: : And why did they have to make us all so sad?...
lines.zh: : 还有，他们为什么非要把我们写得这么悲伤？……

lines.en: scene iobeachint17
: Thanks for walking me back, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你送我回来，老师。

lines.en: : I’m...gonna go spend some time with Uta now.
lines.zh: : 我……现在要去陪 Uta 一会儿。

lines.en: scene black
Io wanders off after leaving me somewhat speechless. Again.
lines.zh: Io 走开了，又留我说不出话来。

lines.en: She’s getting good at that.
lines.zh: 她越来越擅长这个了。

lines.en: scene tree3
It’s all ridiculous, though.
lines.zh: 不过这一切都很荒唐。

lines.en: She saw her mother because that’s what scares her.
lines.zh: 她看见她妈妈，因为那是她害怕的东西。

lines.en: It’s the same reason I see you every time I close my eyes.
lines.zh: 就像我每次闭上眼睛都看见你，也是出于同样的理由。

lines.en: scene iobeachint18
: Hey. Still doing okay in here?
lines.zh: : 嘿。在里面还好吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. Just watching TV.
lines.zh: : 嗯。就在看电视。

lines.en: scene iobeachint19
: Yeah, I...I can see that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我……我看得出来。

lines.en: scene iobeachint20
: It looks like my show ended, though.
lines.zh: : 不过看起来我的节目结束了。

lines.en: : Did you run into Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你碰到老师了吗？

lines.en: : Is he coming?
lines.zh: : 他要来吗？

lines.en: : Uta...
lines.zh: : Uta……

lines.en: : I think today’s going to be the day, Io.
lines.zh: : 我觉得今天就是那一天了，Io。

lines.en: : I think I’m finally going to lose my virginity.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我终于要失去童贞了。

lines.en: : I’m so excited, I can barely breathe.
lines.zh: : 我太兴奋了，兴奋得几乎喘不过气。

lines.en: scene iobeachint21
: Have you taken your medication yet?
lines.zh: : 你吃药了吗？

lines.en: : I don’t understand why I can’t have grapefruit.
lines.zh: : 我不明白为什么我不能吃西柚。

lines.en: : Uta, you need to-
lines.zh: : Uta，你得——

lines.en: : I took it, don’t worry. I love you, Io.
lines.zh: : 我吃了，别担心。我爱你，Io。

lines.en: : Thank you for always taking care of me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你一直照顾我。

lines.en: : Do you want the remote? We can...watch a movie together or something?
lines.zh: : 你要遥控器吗？我们可以……一起看个电影什么的？

lines.en: : He isn’t coming, is he?
lines.zh: : 他不会来，对吧？

lines.en: : You don’t want to see him right now, Uta.
lines.zh: : 你现在不想见他，Uta。

lines.en: scene iobeachint20
: Okay. If that’s what you think is best.
lines.zh: : 好吧。如果你觉得这样最好。

lines.en: : Would you rather I leave you alone?
lines.zh: : 你希望我让你一个人待着吗？

lines.en: : No, you can stay. I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 不，你可以留下。我没事。

lines.en: : You’re not-
lines.zh: : 你才不——

lines.en: : I said I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我说了，我没事。

lines.en: : I said I’m-
lines.zh: : 我说了，我——

lines.en: scene black
: I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : I heard you the first time...
lines.zh: : 我第一次就听见了……
